title: Special periods and some non-tempered cases of the Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture
summary: In this paper, we establish a relationship between special periods and special L-values of automorphic representations of classical groups, and prove the non-tempered global Gan--Gross--Prasad conjecture in several cases. Our approach consists of two main steps. First, inspired by Rallis' tower property, we study the interaction between special periods and the tower property for the genericity of global theta lifts.
